raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation On the per-rank fused shared-slot path, `_post_process_topk_ids` ends with a `_zero_topk_weights_padded_region` launch, once per MoE layer, that exists only to undo what the append kernel left behind. `_fused_append_remap_shared_experts_deepep_kernel` already takes `num_token_non_padded`, but its `HAS_PADDING` branch only fills the routed **ids** for padded rows — it stores the gate's weights untouched, and writes the shared slots unconditionally at `scale_factor`. So a padded row leaves the append with live weights, and a second full pass over `topk_weights` is needed to zero them. ## Modification Zero them in the append instead, on both the routed and the shared tile. The row is already in registers there, so it costs a `tl.where` on each tile, and a padded row now leaves that kernel fully inert. The trailing pass is then redundant whenever the fold was active, so it is skipped in that case. It still runs otherwise, which is required: the append only receives `num_token_non_padded` when the fold is active, so `HAS_PADDING` is false on every other path and those rows are still zeroed by the trailing pass exactly as before. 16 lines across two files. ## Effect Traces Before Traces After One kernel launch per MoE layer disappears, along with a read and a write of `topk_weights` that the preceding kernel does for free. DeepSeek-V4-Pro, MI355X (gfx950), TP8 + DP8 attention + EP8/MoRI with `--enforce-shared-experts-fusion`. Rank-0 device kernel time over a profiled window of 5 decode steps; both arms are the same image and differ only by this commit: | kernel | base calls | base us | patch calls | patch us | | ------ | ---------: | ------: | ----------: | ------: | | `_fused_append_remap_shared_experts_deepep_kernel` | 290 | 1388.9 | 290 | 1256.4 | | `_fill_padded_rows_kernel` | 320 | 1348.2 | 30 | 96.3 | | total | 610 | 2737.1 | 320 | 1352.7 | The pad-fill count drops by exactly 290, the same as the append count, which is the fold engaging one-for-one. That is 58 fewer launches and ~250 us per decode step. The 30 remaining calls are the paths where the fold does not apply, and they are unchanged. **This is not a throughput change, and should not be read as one.** The whole MoE routing stage is ~1% of device kernel time in this configuration, so a saving of this size is well inside run-to-run noise: | metric | base | patch | | ------ | ---- | ----- | | output throughput | 293.97 tok/s | 295.89 tok/s | | total throughput | 4997.57 tok/s | 5030.15 tok/s | | mean TPOT | 115.75 ms | 115.66 ms | It removes redundant work, not a bottleneck. ## Accuracy The risk here is a padded row escaping with a live weight, which is wrong output rather than an error, so accuracy is the check that matters. GSM8K, 1319 questions, parallel 1319: | arm | accuracy | invalid | | --- | -------- | ------- | | base | 0.948 | 0.000 | | patch | 0.951 | 0.000 | The gap is four questions out of 1319, which is inside run-to-run noise for this benchmark; the point is that the padded rows stayed inert, not that the change improves accuracy.
Commands ``` SGLANG_HACK_FLASHMLA_BACKEND=unified_kv_triton \ SGLANG_OPT_FUSE_COMPRESS_NORM_ROPE=1 \ SGLANG_OPT_NATIVE_BPRESHUFFLE_SCALE=1 \ SGLANG_OPT_USE_AITER_BATCHED_GEMM=1 \ AITER_BF16_FP8_MOE_BOUND=0 SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 \ SGLANG_SHARED_EXPERT_TP1=1 SGLANG_DP_SHARED_EXPERT_LOCAL=1 \ SGLANG_DP_USE_GATHERV=1 SGLANG_DP_USE_REDUCE_SCATTER=1 \ GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=5 MORI_SHMEM_MODE=ISOLATION MORI_SHMEM_HEAP_SIZE=8G \ MORI_EP_LAUNCH_CONFIG_MODE=AUTO \ python3 -m sglang.launch_server \ --model-path deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro \ --tensor-parallel-size 8 --dp 8 --enable-dp-attention \ --ep-size 8 --moe-a2a-backend mori --deepep-mode normal \ --moe-dense-tp-size 1 --enable-dp-lm-head \ --attention-backend dsv4 --page-size 256 --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 \ --enforce-shared-experts-fusion \ --context-length 16384 --chunked-prefill-size 8192 \ --mem-fraction-static 0.78 \ --max-running-requests 64 --cuda-graph-max-bs 64 # Trace python3 -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang-oai \ --host 127.0.0.1 --port $PORT --model deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro \ --dataset-name random --random-input-len 8192 --random-output-len 512 \ --random-range-ratio 1.0 --num-prompts 64 --max-concurrency 64 \ --profile --profile-steps 6 --profile-output-dir $OUT # Accuracy python3 benchmark/gsm8k/bench_sglang.py --num-questions 1319 --parallel 1319 ```
Note: both arms are branched from `main` without #36515, so they carry the shared-slot double-append bug identically; it cancels out of this comparison. ## Checklist - [x] Kernel trace shows the launch removed, one-for-one with the append - [x] Accuracy measured on MI355X, 1319 questions, one arm per side - [x] Each arm asserted which side of the change it was on before measuring - [x] Trailing pass still runs on paths where the fold is inactive - [x] No new configuration --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :white_check_mark: [Run #41252077087](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41252077087) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #41252076928](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41252076928) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :x: [Run #41252076819](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41252076819) > [!TIP] > Base CI only covers the core cases, and its workload may not exercise your change. Use `/rerun-test` to run the tests your change touches, or copy this prompt for an agent: > > ```text > Find the registered tests this PR affects and run them with /rerun-test, following https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.agents/skills/rerun-test/SKILL.md > ```

### PR Pundit review

(this is a pilot test of PR Pundit coding agent -- please contact @peymanr for suggestions and feedback. thanks)

| # | | Finding | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🟠 | Env var SGLANG_MORI_NO_PAD_MASK weight behavior changes on per-rank path | `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py:2652` |
| 2 | 🟠 | Gating change untested for per-rank shared-slot path | `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py:2661` |
| 3 | 🔵 | Kernel and wrapper docstrings omit new padded-weight zeroing contract | `python/sglang/kernels/ops/moe/fused_moe_triton_kernels.py:1460` |
| 4 | 🔵 | Redundant flag alias invites divergence between two gated paths | `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py:2819` |

#### 1. 🟠 Should fix: Env var SGLANG_MORI_NO_PAD_MASK weight behavior changes on per-rank path
`python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py:2652`

With `_skip_hip_pad_mask` set, the per-rank path still has `_fold_pad_into_append` true, so the deepep kernel now receives `num_token_non_padded` and zeroes routed/shared weights on padded rows, whereas before they were preserved. This silently changes the 'no pad mask' meaning for weights on per-rank while the non-per-rank path still leaves them. Confirm this behavior change is intended.

_Verified by running it._

#### 2. 🟠 Should fix: Gating change untested for per-rank shared-slot path
`python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py:2661`

The new gating makes `_fold_pad_weights_into_append` true on the HIP+aiter+per-rank path, dropping the trailing `_zero_topk_weights_padded_region` and relying on the kernel; only the kernel is tested directly, not `_post_process_topk_ids`/`select_experts` with `use_per_rank_shared_slots`. A wiring regression forwarding `num_token_non_padded` would leave live weights on padded shared slots uncaught. Add a test exercising the full path.

_Verified by running it._

**Related past reviews:** [#28048](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28048) on `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py`

#### 3. 🔵 Nit: Kernel and wrapper docstrings omit new padded-weight zeroing contract
`python/sglang/kernels/ops/moe/fused_moe_triton_kernels.py:1460`

The kernel docstring still documents shared weights as unconditionally `scale_factor` and does not mention that with `HAS_PADDING` padded rows get all-zero routed and shared weights, and the 'fully inert' comment overstates since padded rows still carry live ids. Callers rely on this zeroing to skip `_zero_topk_weights_padded_region`, so document it. Update the kernel, wrapper, and test module docstrings.

_Verified by running it._

#### 4. 🔵 Nit: Redundant flag alias invites divergence between two gated paths
`python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py:2819`

`_fold_pad_weights_into_append` is now a pure alias of `_fold_pad_into_append`, yet the per-rank append gates on one and the non-per-rank path on the other, inviting silent divergence. Remove the redundant symbol and use `_fold_pad_into_append` everywhere. The new comments near 2819 are also misleading about which path triggers the skip.

_Verified by running it._

**Related past reviews:** [#31323](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/31323) on `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py`, [#20394](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/20394) on `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py`, [#40557](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/40557) on `python/sglang/kernels/ops/quantization/fp8_kernel.py`

Thanks @peymanr / PR Pundit — good catches, all addressed in 239e0322a7.

  1 (🟠) NO_PAD_MASK weight behavior on the per-rank path — fixed, not just confirmed. You're right that this was an
  unintended change. The per-rank (MoRI/DeepEP) id fold engages even under SGLANG_MORI_NO_PAD_MASK because aiter needs
  in-range ids, so aliasing the weight fold to the id fold silently zeroed padded weights that the flag means to leave
  live. The id fill and the weight zeroing are now decoupled in the deepep kernel via a new ZERO_PAD_WEIGHTS constexpr,
  and the gate is _fold_pad_weights_into_append = _fold_pad_into_append and not _skip_hip_pad_mask. So under NO_PAD_MASK
  the padded ids are still filled but the weights stay live — exact pre-PR semantics on both paths.

  2 (🟠) Per-rank gating untested — added. New test_post_process_per_rank_pad_weight_gating drives the full
  _post_process_topk_ids on the HIP+aiter per-rank path (patched globals + get_parallel) for both NO_PAD_MASK values and
  n_valid in {0, m/2, m}: asserts padded routed/shared weights are zeroed when the flag is off, left live (routed
  passthrough, shared 1.0) when on, and that padded ids are filled in both cases. Verified it fails on the pre-fix
  aliasing and passes on the fix (ran on MI355X; full file 7 passed / 57 subtests).

  3 (🔵) Docstrings — updated. Kernel, wrapper, and test-module docstrings now document the padded-weight contract and
  the ZERO_PAD_WEIGHTS vs. id-fill split; dropped the "fully inert" overstatement (padded rows still carry live ids).

  4 (🔵) Redundant alias — resolved by keeping it meaningful rather than removing it. Collapsing to a single symbol would
  reintroduce finding 1 (the per-rank path needs the id fold on but the weight fold off under NO_PAD_MASK).
  _fold_pad_weights_into_append now genuinely differs from _fold_pad_into_append on exactly that case, and the deepep
  call passes both explicitly (num_token_non_padded for the fill, zero_pad_weights for the zero). Fixed the misleading
  trailing-skip comment to name the real gate.

files.patch:
@@ -1450,6 +1450,7 @@ def _fused_append_remap_shared_experts_deepep_kernel(
     BLOCK_K: tl.constexpr,
     BLOCK_S: tl.constexpr,
     HAS_PADDING: tl.constexpr,
+    ZERO_PAD_WEIGHTS: tl.constexpr,
 ):
     """Append shared experts AND apply the DeepEP interleaved remap in one pass.
 
@@ -1462,6 +1463,16 @@ def _fused_append_remap_shared_experts_deepep_kernel(
                   the shared slots that precede this id's rank)
     Shared IDs:   shared_id_base + arange(S)        (one id per shared slot)
     Shared wgt:   scale_factor                     (1.0 on aiter; 1/rsf otherwise)
+
+    Padding (HAS_PADDING): rows >= num_token_non_padded get pad_fill_id in every
+    routed id slot so aiter never sees an out-of-range id. Such a row still
+    carries live routed and shared ids; it is routed nowhere only once its
+    weights are zeroed. ZERO_PAD_WEIGHTS gates that weight zeroing -- when set it
+    zeroes both the routed and the shared weights on padded rows, folding the
+    caller's separate _zero_topk_weights_padded_region pass. It is kept separate
+    from the id fill because SGLANG_MORI_NO_PAD_MASK keeps the fill (aiter needs
+    in-range ids) but deliberately leaves the padded weights live, so that path
+    passes HAS_PADDING with ZERO_PAD_WEIGHTS off.
     """
     pid = tl.program_id(0)
 
@@ -1490,10 +1501,18 @@ def _fused_append_remap_shared_experts_deepep_kernel(
         # launch): rows >= num_token_non_padded get pad_fill_id in every routed
         # slot. Matches the old fill(topk_ids=0) -> remap(0)=0 when pad_fill_id==0.
         # ids is a BLOCK_K-wide register tile (K need not be pow2), so fill the
-        # whole tile and let the masked store below drop the tail.
+        # whole tile and let the masked store below drop the tail. A padded row
+        # still carries live routed/shared ids after this; it is routed nowhere
+        # only once ZERO_PAD_WEIGHTS zeroes its weights.
         n_valid = tl.load(num_token_non_padded_ptr)
-        if pid >= n_valid:
-            ids = tl.full((BLOCK_K,), pad_fill_id, dtype=ids.dtype)
+        keep = pid < n_valid
+        ids = tl.where(keep, ids, tl.full((BLOCK_K,), pad_fill_id, dtype=ids.dtype))
+        if ZERO_PAD_WEIGHTS:
+            # Fold the trailing _zero_topk_weights_padded_region pass: zero the
+            # routed weights here and the shared weights below so the caller can
+            # drop that separate per-layer launch. Gated off (while the id fill
+            # stays on) for SGLANG_MORI_NO_PAD_MASK, which keeps weights live.
+            ws = tl.where(keep, ws, tl.zeros((BLOCK_K,), dtype=ws.dtype))
 
     tl.store(out_ids_ptr + out_ids_row_ptr + offs_k, ids, mask=mask_k)
     tl.store(out_weights_ptr + out_ids_row_ptr + offs_k, ws, mask=mask_k)
@@ -1502,6 +1521,10 @@ def _fused_append_remap_shared_experts_deepep_kernel(
     mask_s = offs_s < S
     shared_ids = tl.cast(shared_id_base + offs_s, ids.dtype)
     shared_ws = tl.full([BLOCK_S], scale_factor, dtype=ws.dtype)
+    if ZERO_PAD_WEIGHTS:
+        # keep is defined whenever ZERO_PAD_WEIGHTS is set: the wrapper only
+        # enables it alongside HAS_PADDING (num_token_non_padded is not None).
+        shared_ws = tl.where(keep, shared_ws, tl.zeros([BLOCK_S], dtype=ws.dtype))
 
     tl.store(out_ids_ptr + out_ids_row_ptr + K + offs_s, shared_ids, mask=mask_s)
     tl.store(out_weights_ptr + out_ids_row_ptr + K + offs_s, shared_ws, mask=mask_s)
@@ -1516,12 +1539,20 @@ def fused_append_remap_shared_experts_deepep(
     num_local_routed,
     num_token_non_padded=None,
     pad_fill_id=0,
+    zero_pad_weights=True,
 ):
     """Fused append + DeepEP remap (see kernel docstring).
 
     Fused form of topk.remap_topk_for_per_rank_shared_slots() for
     the aiter/DeepEP-class path. Host computes the scalar remap params so the
     kernel stays branch-free.
+
+    When ``num_token_non_padded`` is given the kernel fills padded rows'

|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 🟠 | Env var SGLANG_MORI_NO_PAD_MASK weight behavior changes on per-rank path | `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py:2652` |

| 4 | 🔵 | Redundant flag alias invites divergence between two gated paths | `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py:2819` |

#### 1. 🟠 Should fix: Env var SGLANG_MORI_NO_PAD_MASK weight behavior changes on per-rank path
`python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py:2652`

With `_skip_hip_pad_mask` set, the per-rank path still has `_fold_pad_into_append` true, so the deepep kernel now receives `num_token_non_padded` and zeroes routed/shared weights on padded rows, whereas before they were preserved. This silently changes the 'no pad mask' meaning for weights on per-rank while the non-per-rank path still leaves them. Confirm this behavior change is intended.

_Verified by running it._

#### 2. 🟠 Should fix: Gating change untested for per-rank shared-slot path
`python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py:2661`

The new gating makes `_fold_pad_weights_into_append` true on the HIP+aiter+per-rank path, dropping the trailing `_zero_topk_weights_padded_region` and relying on the kernel; only the kernel is tested directly, not `_post_process_topk_ids`/`select_experts` with `use_per_rank_shared_slots`. A wiring regression forwarding `num_token_non_padded` would leave live weights on padded shared slots uncaught. Add a test exercising the full path.

_Verified by running it._

**Related past reviews:** [#28048](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/28048) on `python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py`

#### 3. 🔵 Nit: Kernel and wrapper docstrings omit new padded-weight zeroing contract
`python/sglang/kernels/ops/moe/fused_moe_triton_kernels.py:1460`

The kernel docstring still documents shared weights as unconditionally `scale_factor` and does not mention that with `HAS_PADDING` padded rows get all-zero routed and shared weights, and the 'fully inert' comment overstates since padded rows still carry live ids. Callers rely on this zeroing to skip `_zero_topk_weights_padded_region`, so document it. Update the kernel, wrapper, and test module docstrings.

_Verified by running it._

#### 4. 🔵 Nit: Redundant flag alias invites divergence between two gated paths
`python/sglang/srt/layers/moe/topk.py:2819`

`_fold_pad_weights_into_append` is now a pure alias of `_fold_pad_into_append`, yet the per-rank append gates on one and the non-per-rank path on the other, inviting silent divergence. Remove the redundant symbol and use `_fold_pad_into_append` everywhere. The new comments near 2819 are also misleading about which path triggers the skip.

_Verified by running it._

Thanks @peymanr / PR Pundit — good catches, all addressed in 239e0322a7.

  1 (🟠) NO_PAD_MASK weight behavior on the per-rank path — fixed, not just confirmed. You're right that this was an
  unintended change. The per-rank (MoRI/DeepEP) id fold engages even under SGLANG_MORI_NO_PAD_MASK because aiter needs
  in-range ids, so aliasing the weight fold to the id fold silently zeroed padded weights that the flag means to leave
  live. The id fill and the weight zeroing are now decoupled in the deepep kernel via a new ZERO_PAD_WEIGHTS constexpr,
  and the gate is _fold_pad_weights_into_append = _fold_pad_into_append and not _skip_hip_pad_mask. So under NO_PAD_MASK
  the padded ids are still filled but the weights stay live — exact pre-PR semantics on both paths.

  2 (🟠) Per-rank gating untested — added. New test_post_process_per_rank_pad_weight_gating drives the full
  _post_process_topk_ids on the HIP+aiter per-rank path (patched globals + get_parallel) for both NO_PAD_MASK values and
  n_valid in {0, m/2, m}: asserts padded routed/shared weights are zeroed when the flag is off, left live (routed
  passthrough, shared 1.0) when on, and that padded ids are filled in both cases. Verified it fails on the pre-fix
  aliasing and passes on the fix (ran on MI355X; full file 7 passed / 57 subtests).

  3 (🔵) Docstrings — updated. Kernel, wrapper, and test-module docstrings now document the padded-weight contract and
  the ZERO_PAD_WEIGHTS vs. id-fill split; dropped the "fully inert" overstatement (padded rows still carry live ids).

  4 (🔵) Redundant alias — resolved by keeping it meaningful rather than removing it. Collapsing to a single symbol would
  reintroduce finding 1 (the per-rank path needs the id fold on but the weight fold off under NO_PAD_MASK).
  _fold_pad_weights_into_append now genuinely differs from _fold_pad_into_append on exactly that case, and the deepep
  call passes both explicitly (num_token_non_padded for the fill, zero_pad_weights for the zero). Fixed the misleading
  trailing-skip comment to name the real gate.
